fields.title: Menstrual Hygiene Awareness Session
fields.summary: An open conversation on menstrual hygiene, creating a space where the topic feels normal and empowering.
fields.body:
Nayi Raah is more than just a project — it is a journey of awareness, learning and meaningful change. In this session, we visited and spoke about menstrual hygiene, hoping to create a space where such important conversations feel open, normal and empowering.

It was a small step, but one that reflects the larger purpose behind Nayi Raah: to support, educate and uplift with care and compassion. Every conversation like this brings us closer to a more aware and supportive community.
